translations.web: Yahweh, don’t I hate those who hate you? Am I not grieved with those who rise up against you?
translations.bsb: Do I not hate those who hate You, O LORD, and detest those who rise against You?
translations.kjv: Do not I hate them, O LORD, that hate thee? and am not I grieved with those that rise up
translations.asv: Do not I hate them, O Jehovah, that hate thee? And am not I grieved with those that rise up against thee?
